unmet.note: Must come from the Natural Science & Technology (NST) list, in addition to courses used for General Education, and be allowed for credit by Grainger Engineering. Exceptions: ASTR 100, PHYS 101, PHYS 102, CHEM 101. The NST list is a separate catalog list and is NOT yet loaded: add allowsCourse links from it.

unmet.requirement: Team project course (at least 1 of the technical electives)
unmet.note: At least one CS course used as a technical elective must come from this list. CS 425 only counts for the 4 hour section.

unmet.requirement: Technical electives (min 6 courses, 18 hours)
unmet.note: At least 6 additional technical electives totalling at least 18 credit hours, chosen from CS 397 and CS 400-level courses, not including CS 400, CS 401, CS 402, CS 403 or CS 491. CS 500-level courses only with special permission from the CS Academic Office. CS 397 and CS 499 count with a cumulative maximum of 6 credits as technical electives. One "CS-like" course in another department may count as a CS 400-level course with CS Academic Office permission; non-CS technical electives are not considered in focus areas. Allowed courses are generated from catalog data by rule R4.

result_guide.semantics: Render EVERY requirement row, INCLUDING zero remainingCourses. Remaining credits are max(0,minCredits-allocatedCredits) when minCredits is known, otherwise unknown. Focus areas are alternatives, not eight compulsory requirements. Do not add overlapping group totals.
